sources.title: Visa Information for Foreigners — Libya
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: Türkiye's live Foreign Ministry nationality schedule expressly distinguishes ordinary Libyan passport holders by age and separately makes eVisa availability dependent on specified third-country documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ordinary passport holders between the age of 16 and 45 are required to have visa.

sources.title: Suspension of Visa Issuance to Foreign Nationals to Protect the Security of the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Department of State notice implements Presidential Proclamation 10998 and expressly names Libya in the full visa-issuance suspension, subject to limited exceptions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: fully suspended visa issuance to nationals of 19 countries ... Libya

conflicts.officialStatus: age-conditional ordinary-passport visa exemption and advance-visa requirement; third-country-document-conditioned evisa
conflicts.explanation: Türkiye exempts ordinary Libyan passport holders under 16 or over 45 for tourist visits, requires a visa for ages 16–45, and limits that cohort's eVisa route to holders of specified third-country visas or residence permits. That cannot be flattened to an unconditional eVisa status.

Effective 1 January 2026, the current U.S. measure fully suspends issuance for Libyan nationals across immigrant and nonimmigrant categories, subject to limited exceptions and valid-visa grandfathering; it is not an ordinary advance-visa baseline.
